scope: Ticket 01 seed cases only. Other tickets must extend this index; this is not the complete 105+45 or E1-E7/R1-R7 acceptance matrix.

requirements.title: Independent Common Event saved-state roundtrip through actual Workspace source evaluation

sources.section: ### T1 — 已确认的测试边界与现有基础

requirements.input: One self-authored Common Event, inactive default switchId, Show Text with literal CR and trailing empty continuation, Comment with trailing empty continuation, final code 0; minimal independent standard project data.
requirements.expected: Complete parsed CommonEvents.json and System.json equal the independent fixture. All generated definition files appear in compile manifest Discovery; changing generated source changes compiled event name, then restoration restores exact data. Project Root and complete Snapshot remain unchanged.

test.name: MV-S0-CE-001: discovers and evaluates Decompiled Source against independent saved data

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22; no editor, game runtime, assets, or local references required
execution.owner: Automated test runner; agent records reviewed run
execution.layer: Actual temporary filesystem and public Workspace API

requirements.title: Strict complete saved-state comparison detects structural and value losses
requirements.input: Independent copies with one mutation each: final 0 removed, indent key removed, CR removed, trailing empty text record removed, inactive switchId changed, leading null removed, empty array changed to null, external unknown field removed.
requirements.expected: The identical deepStrictEqual comparator used in the Workspace roundtrip rejects every mutation. Neither operand is filtered or normalized.

test.name: MV-S0-COMPARE-001: rejects every saved-state loss without normalizing either side

execution.environment: Windows / Node 22; independent synthetic JSON only
execution.owner: Automated test runner; agent records reviewed run
